notes.title: Hotfix 2.5.61 Live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I was getting reports that Level 3 (Some of you got that far?!) was suffering from poor performance.

After investigating, This was because 250 giant ghosts were spawning as soon as you started.

Thanks to your reports - I've fixed it and it's now sorted (Hopefully!)

I've also fixed the bug where you could jump out of the map on Level #3 - If you try to now, You'll die (But I'm sure you're used to that by now)?

As always, Thanks for all your support! - Be sure to shoot me an email if you find anymore bugs! - contact@kitatusstudios.co.uk

P.S I apologize about all these bugs; It's super embarrassing; But it's really nice to see you're all being totally awesome about it - So thanks!

P.P.S - I'm totally making this Hotfix numbers up.

notes.title: Update 1.1 Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone and thanks for all the feedback so far - It's been super-awesome!

I've gone ahead and implemented as much as I can into the first update; Here's a list of the fixed bugs so far:

- Fixed "Options menu stuck open" bug
- Turned down the audio on enemies bullets
- Fixed "Audio options" bug
- Fixed Achievements
- Added Level 4 - Spooky Spooky Manor
- Adjusting player control to feel less "Floaty"
- Various gameplay tweaks
- Random bug fixes in enemy behaviour

If you find any more bugs or anything - Feel free to either post them in the comments or shoot me an email: contact@kitatusstudios.co.uk

Thanks for being awesome and have fun gaming! ;)

notes.title: Thanks for all your feedback + First update / Bug Fixes Coming! (+ Mac / Linux version!)
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
Thanks for the awesome response - You rock!

All the trading card errors should now be fixed - But thanks to your reviews (Which are randomly glitching out, But hold in there - I've contacted Valve and they should return soon!)

Next week, I'll be uploading the first of the bug fixes for the bugs you have all found. It's my fault that I didn't notice them sooner - So expect a bug fix within the next week!

I'll also be adding the first free map as a thank-you to you all in the update so look out for that!

Bugs I'm going to be fixing for update #1:
Fixing Achievement bug
Fixing audio bug
Making sure the enemies don't throw you too far
"Floating Death" will be fixed
Fixing Parralax issue on level #1
Stopping enemy bullets will no longer push through floors
Enemy bullet speed will be changed so you have time to react
Changing volume slider will be a percentage rather than a number

Major props to (@SamCoIndustries) for finding these!

I'll also make tweaks to the controls to make sure they don't seem as "Floaty"

Thanks for all this feedback everyone - I hope I can get it all fixed soon!

EDIT: The update should be out within the new 2-3 days - Been working on localisation improvements!
